title: Photo Duo 059 · 아워글래스 USSBBW × 머슬 아워글래스 BBW · 기대기 + 앉기
prompt:
Image format: a horizontal landscape-orientation photograph, 3:2 aspect ratio, wider than it is tall.

A photograph of TWO women on a low platform with a padded backrest at its left end and a short stone bench at its right end, a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, the camera set close at platform level so the two of them fill the frame edge to edge, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking in from one side — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Subjects: TWO real adult women, both far beyond any real person in size, one reclining against the backrest at the left of the frame with her legs stretched out toward the right, the other sitting upright on the stone bench at the right and rising to fill the full height of the picture, their two bodies together filling the frame from edge to edge and top to bottom with almost no empty backdrop left, and where they meet in the middle the flesh presses together and bulges out.

Reclining woman at the left: an East African woman in her late 50s, deep umber skin with a warm sheen, her face exactly the same tone as her body, a neat low bun with a lacquered pin. A colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size — the one place on her body where the outline pulls inward. Below it an immense mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and spills forward down the slope of her raised torso under its own weight, piling over her thighs and reaching toward her knees in three or four heavy rounded folds with deep creases between them, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, merging seamlessly into her sides, hips and thighs with no boundary anywhere, not pregnant. Colossal hips more than three times the width of that waistline and a gigantic rear, each thigh thicker than a normal woman's waist. Painted in Korean eunipsa silver inlay — a deep black ground with thick bright silver linework and fine lattice fills, a bold silver band following every deep crease, catching the light the way paint on skin does rather than like real metal.

Seated woman at the right: a Latina woman in her late 30s, warm golden-tan skin with olive undertones, her face exactly the same tone as her body, shoulder-length glossy curls. Huge rounded shoulders and massive arms with the swell of the biceps showing through a soft layer of fat, a colossal bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly, the muscle of her core firm beneath it. Below it a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and settles down over her thighs as she sits, spreading forward and outward under its own weight in two or three heavy rounded folds with deep creases between them, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, merging seamlessly into her sides, hips and thighs with no boundary anywhere, not pregnant. Enormous round hips, a gigantic powerful rear, colossal thighs with the sweep of the quads visible under a soft layer, no bodybuilder leanness. Her hips spread wide and flatten against the seat, the flesh of her thighs bulging out above and below where the hard front edge presses into them. Painted in Mexican Talavera — a glossy white tin glaze painted with cobalt blue, marigold yellow, terracotta orange and green rosettes, star medallions and scalloped borders, a thick cobalt border following every curve.

The reclining woman's arms rest back on the platform behind her hips with the elbows out; the seated woman's hands rest on the stone beside her hips. On both: real photographic skin with visible pores, creases where the flesh folds and faint stretch marks, no illustration finish, no CG sheen. The paint is pigment on living skin, distorting over every bulge and cracking where it folds, covering everything below the jaw with no bare skin left; their faces unpainted, the pattern fading out at the neck. Neither arm crosses in front of her own body or the other woman's, both faces toward the camera. Every fold keeps its own rounded outline with a deep crease between them, never one shapeless mass; arms, hands and legs in correct proportion. Both wear extreme platform stiletto heels with soles as tall as their ankle bones.

Horizontal 3:2 landscape-orientation photograph, wider than it is tall.
